scripts.lint: tools/eslint/node_modules/.bin/eslint app test/electron forge.config.ts vite.main.config.ts vite.preload.config.ts vite.renderer.config.ts vitest.config.ts --config tools/eslint/eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings=0
scripts.format: prettier --write app test/electron forge.config.ts vite.*.config.ts vitest.config.ts tools/eslint package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check app test/electron forge.config.ts vite.*.config.ts vitest.config.ts tools/eslint package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.test: pnpm run test:project && pnpm run test:native && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:companion
scripts.test:native: cmake -S . -B build/native -G Ninja -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build/native && ctest --test-dir build/native --output-on-failure
